{{Short description|Legislative district of the Philippines}} [[File:Camarines_Norte_Legislative_Districts.png|thumb|right|250px|Districts of Camarines Norte]] {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative districts of Camarines Norte''' are the representations of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Camarines Norte]] in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|various national legislatures]] of the [[Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the [[Congress of the Philippines]] through its [[#1st District|first]] and [[#2nd District|second]] congressional districts. == History == [[Camarines Norte]] was represented as part of [[Legislative districts of Ambos Camarines|Ambos Camarines]], particularly the [[Ambos Camarines's at-large congressional district|at-large district]] in the [[Malolos Congress]] from 1898 to 1899 and the [[Ambos Camarines's 1st congressional district|first]] and [[Ambos Camarines's 2nd congressional district|second]] districts beginning in 1907, prior to being granted its own representation, after the division of [[Ambos Camarines]] in 1919 into Norte and [[Camarines Sur|Sur]]. From 1978 to 1984, it was part of the representation of [[Interim Batasang Pambansa|Region V]]. The passage of Republic Act No. 9725 in 2009 abolished the lone district and divided the province into two districts starting in the [[2010 Philippine House of Representatives elections|2010 elections]].{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=9725|url=http://www.senate.gov.ph/republic_acts/ra%209725.pdf|title=An Act Providing For The Reapportionment Of The Lone Legislative District Of The Province Of Camarines Norte|date=October 22, 2009|accessdate=September 11, 2022}} == Current Districts == {| class="wikitable sortable" style="margin: 1em auto; font-size:100%; line-height:20px; text-align:center" |+Legislative districts and representatives of [[Camarines Norte]] !District ! colspan="3" |Current Representative !Party !Constituent [[Local government in the Philippines|LGUs]] !Population (2020) !Area !Map |- !
